exposure: Children born to women from the general population
cohort: All WLWH giving birth to one or more children in Denmark after 31 December 1999 and their children
finding: HIV-exposed, but uninfected children born to WLWH had a lower median birth weight and gestational age and were at higher risk of intrauterine growth retardation and hospital admission compared with children born to women from the general population.
mod_finding: The study examined mode of delivery and predictors of emergency cesarean section in women living with HIV.
followup_time: At birth and up to 4 years of age
